summary: Tested Global Nutrition Prices and Global Ledger APIs for Sports Nutrition Trading section. All 13 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI correctly displays global prices with % fluctuations and integrates with global blockchain ledger. The fix ensures ALL users see the SAME prices, fluctuations, and transaction ledger in real-time.
seed_data_creation: Test transactions created via POST /api/nutrition/global-ledger/record during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Global nutrition prices and ledger APIs fully functional. Backend stores GLOBAL_NUTRITION_PRICES state that updates every 3 seconds. All users fetch from same endpoint and see identical prices. Global ledger stores all transactions in MongoDB and is visible to all users.

features_tested.feature: GET /api/nutrition/global-prices returns same prices for all users
features_tested.details: API returns prices dict with 40 products, each having current price, change %, and 20-point history

features_tested.feature: GET /api/nutrition/global-ledger returns all transactions from all users
features_tested.details: API returns transactions array with blockchain-style fields (tx_hash, block_number, confirmations)
Authenticated endpoint creates transaction with blockchain verification data

features_tested.feature: Frontend fetches global prices every 3 seconds from backend
features_tested.details: useEffect hook in FtcMining.js polls /api/nutrition/global-prices every 3 seconds

features_tested.details: useEffect hook in FtcMining.js polls /api/nutrition/global-ledger every 5 seconds
